questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw potatoes are harvested across all farms in Ireland in a single year?
reasoning: Ireland harvests potatoes across roughly 85000 hectares of land
Average potato yield is about 4000 kilograms per hectare
Multiplying 85000 hectares by 4000 kilograms gives approximately 340 million kilograms
Refined closer to standard annual production reports at 350 million kilograms

questions.prompt: How many total individual plastic bottles are sold across all convenience stores in South Korea in a single year?
reasoning: South Korea has roughly 50000 convenience stores operating nationwide
Each store sells an average of about 250 bottled drinks per day
Multiplying 50000 stores by 250 bottles gives 12.5 million daily sales
Multiplying daily sales by 365 days yields approximately 4.5 billion bottles per year

questions.prompt: How many total hours do all domestic pet cats kept in households across Sweden sleep collectively in a single day?
reasoning: The pet cat population in Sweden is estimated at approximately 1.3 million cats
An average domestic cat spends about 16 hours a day sleeping
Multiplying 1.3 million cats by 16 hours results in 20.8 million collective hours
Accounting for age variations and differing sleep schedules to confirm the total
